title: Version 1.36.0
body:
Version 1.36.0

August 9th, 2023

Added:

  • Secret Update Friday Content (ER, BSk)

Changes:

  • Made the planker conveyor faster

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed statistic tool not showing the correct rough plank price
  • Fixed neon light not having a color
  • Fixed issues with elevators in structure form
